purpose: Prioritize the frozen eight reception cells for a source-supported C/D vessel training reservation before pixels or scores
rank: Existing shortlist order, nearest AIS time offset, AIS bracket gap, alignment uncertainty, product UUID, private source identity
source_criteria: Unchanged source_supported_v010: nearest <=120 s, bracket <=240 s, uncertainty <=500 m, speed >=1 kt, reference water >=500 m from shore
limits: Reservation is metadata/source selection; native pixels, product processor version, object identity and permitted use still need checks before provisional training admission.
The existing motion screen is a conservative discovery choice, not a definition of vessel or evidence that slow vessels are absent.
If no qualifying overlap exists, reserve zero acquisitions and retain explicit prospective priorities; never lower source or split requirements to fill a batch.
Catalogue midpoint support must be checked at native object time; source-relative land/water and shoreline distances are not imagery-verified truth.
Complete available competing pools are retained privately; the receiver cannot establish complete area-wide AIS coverage.
Existing protected roles, prior exposure and identities remain excluded. Adjacent cells and slices do not create independent examples.
No images or model scores are consulted for selection. No independent review, accuracy truth, training approval or promotion is supplied.
